Senses.Explanation: The omitted-look procedure names the deletion of 顧, “look,” from the sequence 顧、鑒、咦. Dahui Zonggao says that later students made a point of 顧 and that it was therefore removed; the Sanshanlai record gives the same account, while the Ancient Venerable Masters record preserves a verse heading for the procedure.
